title: String Duper 99 BACKPORT
description: This project is a backport of my string duper mod for 1.18.2. Made this for a friend,
body:
This data pack is a backport of the String Duper 99 by Brick, optimized for the 1.18 Caves & Cliffs update. It restores string duplication mechanics. 

I know there might a already working string duping method in this version, but this is a lot more simple.

You simply place a string into a crafting table and now your inventory is full of string!

Server owners please understand that infinite string ALSO means infinite wool, and thus infinite fuel. Just saying
